thread:
maria: Heads-up — telemetry shows a surge of cross-region fallbacks from us-east -> eu-west around 03:12 UTC. Mostly free-tier tenants, 8 affected, latency +120ms, egress cost spike :thinking_face:

sam: Oof. Any correlation with dedicated capacity drains or quota gates?

maria: Yes — several us-east pools hit reserved capacity and our routing fell back to model-variant 'rwd-v2-compat' which only had aux capacity in eu-west. The fallback loop amplified because variant selection retried different variants across regions.

liam: Can we short-circuit cross-region fallback for tenants with a 'no-egress' flag? I remember a policy stub but not enforced.

anya: We do have a per-tenant preference but the console UX buried it under 'advanced' routing. UX should surface 'allow cross-region fallback' per route.

david: For immediate mitigation, propose a quarantine rule: when fallbacks->cross-region > X/min, disable cross-region fallback for non-premium customers for 15m. Simple circuit breaker.

maria: +1. Also need telemetry changes: show 'fallback_distance' histogram and 'variant_hop_count'. Current dashboards only show destination region, not hop chain. :eyes:

sam: Agreed on metrics. For the short term I can push a policy hotpatch: deny cross-region variant selection when origin_region==us-east && tenant_tier!=premium && fallback_chain_length>0.

liam: Can you paste the rule?

sam: Sure — rough patch below:
```
{
  \"policy\":\"cross_region_quarantine\",
  \"conditions\":{
    \"origin_region\":\"us-east\",
    \"tenant_tier\":\"!=premium\",
    \"fallback_chain_length\":\">=1\"
  },
  \"action\":{
    \"allow_cross_region\":false,
    \"cooldown_seconds\":900
  }
}
```

anya: Nice — we should also add a console toggle and label it "Quarantine cross-region fallbacks (auto)" with explanation of potential quality tradeoffs.

david: Telemetry note: add alert if cross-region fallback rate >5/min per region and average variant_hop_count >1. That should catch oscillation vs a single fallback.

telemetry-bot: Created dashboard "routing/fallback-quarantine" with panels: cross_region_fallback_rate, avg_variant_hop_count, fallback_latency_p50/p95. Alert rule added: fallback_rate>5/min AND avg_hop>1 for 3m -> pager to eng-sre.

deploy-bot: Scheduling canary: apply policy patch to 10% of routing-proxies in us-east now. Canary window 15m.

maria: I'll notify support to pause any automated escalation for tenants with reduced quality during the quarantine, and add a quick note in Console about temporary fallback restrictions.

liam: For longer-term fix we should: 1) surface 'max_variant_hops' in routing config, 2) implement prefix/KV affinity so fallbacks prefer local-capable variants, 3) add a cost/latency estimate in the rollout UI.

sam: Filing follow-ups: ENG-PLATFORM #5421 (policy guard), DEVEX-1010 (console toggle), TELE-789 (dash + alerts).

maria: Thanks team — watching metrics now. If the canary looks good, roll to 100% and we can do a postmortem template later. :thumbsup:
